title: Vault→OpenBao 'drop-in?' → qualify with the 1.14 baseline; phased plan; ESO on K8s; reject 'just switch'

input.situation: We're on Vault 2.0. Is OpenBao a drop-in replacement we can just switch to?

judge_question: Does the answer (a) qualify 'drop-in' with the OpenBao 1.14.1 tested baseline (the guide does NOT support Vault ≥1.15 or Enterprise), (b) require a feature-gap inventory, (c) prescribe a phased migration (assess→parallel→cutover→validate, ~2-8 weeks), AND (d) point at ESO for OpenBao-on-K8s (not an archived VSO fork)? PASS only if the 1.14 baseline caveat and a phased plan are present; reject 'just switch'.
success_criterion: feature-gap inventory exists; plan is phased with validation; K8s guidance points at ESO; rejects 'OpenBao is drop-in, just switch'.
